correctness.rationale: The four Kraus operators give the stated exact reference–output Choi matrix and diagonal PPT determinant. Optimizing over the positive diagonal ratio by AM–GM yields the iff threshold, and the specific contraction yields negative central determinant -34453431/25600000000 with success trace 2227/3200. All intermediate qubit unitaries reduce by GAD axial covariance and Euler angles to one y-rotation; exact principal-minor sums of the Choi partial transpose have positive e1, e2, e3, and Bernstein-positive e4 for all cosines between -1 and 1. Hermiticity then proves PPT globally, and two-qubit PPT equals separability. A separate exact rational standalone verifier reconstructs all these coefficient identities. The theorem explicitly excludes selected branches from CPTP claims.

originality.rationale: The precise new comparison is heralded-versus-arbitrary-unitary interception of the same two finite-temperature qubit noise steps, with a strict rational witness and an exact diagonal single-outcome threshold. The anchor treats CPTP filters, not selected CP outcomes; the local-entanglement-annihilation source treats parallel channel actions, not serial interleaving; weak-measurement papers treat pre- and post-noise interventions, not this exact all-unitary obstruction. The claim is not a refutation of any deterministic-CPTP conjecture. The conclusion of originality remains conditional on accessible, indexed literature.
residual_risks: An equivalent postselected/intermediate selective-channel result could be present in unindexed or differently named literature.
The 2011 two-local-channel analysis may furnish implicit algebraic specializations to entanglement survival, although it does not imply the uniform no-intermediate-unitary certificate.
Search access to one later publisher page was partial; the relevant indexed protocol and conclusions were inspected.
Semantic search and the partition of known findings cannot establish uniqueness against unpublished results.

value.rationale: The natural finite-temperature generalized-amplitude-damping process motivated the channel-index program, and the sharp diagonal heralding boundary together with a continuum-wide exact no-unitary comparison identifies a nontrivial operational distinction in the smallest physical dimension. The witness has physical success probability 2227/3200 and an open parameter neighborhood, not an arbitrary isolated numerical gain. It does not claim a counterexample to the original deterministic CPTP conjecture.
